title: Protocol for whole-tissue immunolabeling, optical clearing, and lightsheet imaging of c-Fos protein expression in unsectioned mouse brains
markdown:
## Protocol: Protocol for whole-tissue immunolabeling, optical clearing, and lightsheet imaging of c-Fos protein expression in unsectioned mouse brains

### Overview

This protocol describes: Protocol for whole-tissue immunolabeling, optical clearing, and lightsheet imaging of c-Fos protein expression in unsectioned mouse brains.

### Materials/Reagents

Refer to the source-grounded procedure steps for required reagents.

### Equipment

Refer to the source-grounded procedure steps for required equipment.

### Safety & Sterility

Follow the source-supported safety requirements and institutional procedures.

## Reagent Preparation

### Pre-experiment (Stock Solutions)

1. Prepare Formaldehyde Stock Solution (4%). a. Add 40 g of paraformaldehyde powder to 950 mL ddH2O preheated to 60◦C. b. Add 5 M NaOH dropwise with gentle stirring until paraformaldehyde powder is completelydissolved. c. Adjust the final volume to 1000 mL with ddH2O. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: The pH of the solution should be 7.4. Adjust if needed. Note: This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 4◦C. CRITICAL: Handle paraformaldehyde in a chemical hood and dispose it according to local health and safety regulations. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S02 -->
2. Prepare Heparin Stock Solution (10 mg/mL). a. Add 1 g of heparin sodium powder into 100 mL ddH2O. b. Rotate until heparin is completely dissolved. c. Filter the solution through a 0.22-μm syringe filter. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S03 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 4◦C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S04 -->
3. Prepare 20%, 40%, 60%, 80% (v/v) methanol in ddH2O. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S05 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 22◦C-25◦C. CRITICAL: Handle methanol in a chemical hood and dispose the methanol-containing solutions according to local health and safety regulations. CRITICAL: Use glass containers (i.e., bottles and vials) with polypropylene caps and styrene-butadiene rubber liners for handling organic solvents (i.e., methanol, dichloro methane, and dibenzyl ether) throughout this protocol. The organic solvents, especially dichloromethane, can easily erode common plastic labware (e.g., pipettes, tubes, and dishes). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S06 -->
4. Prepare Decolorization Solution. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S07 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: This can be done 1 day in advance. Precool the Decolorization Solution to 4◦C before use. CRITICAL: Handle methanol and H2O2 in a chemical hood and dispose them according to local health and safety regulations. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S08 -->
5. Prepare EDTA-Na Stock Solution (0.5 M). a. Add 73 g of EDTA to 480 mL ddH2O. b. Add 5 M NaOH dropwise with gentle stirring until EDTA powder is completely dissolved. c. Adjust the final volume to 500 mL with ddH2O. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S09 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: The pH of the solution should be 8.0. Adjust if needed. Note: This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 4◦C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S10 -->
6. Prepare Triton X-100 Stock Solution (10% (w/v)). a. Add 5 g of Triton X-100 to 40 mL ddH2O. b. Continuously stir until solution becomes visually homogeneous. c. Adjust the final volume to 50 mL with ddH2O. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S11 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 4◦C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S12 -->
7. Prepare Deoxycholate Stock Solution (5% (w/v)). a. Add 5 g of deoxycholate powder to 90 mL ddH2O. b. Adjust the final volume to 100 mL with ddH2O. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S13 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 4◦C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S14 -->
8. Prepare Tween 20 Stock Solution (10% (w/v)). a. Add 10 g of Tween 20 to 85 mL ddH2O. b. Continuously stir until solution becomes visually homogeneous. c. Adjust the final volume to 100 mL with ddH2O. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S15 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 4◦C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S16 -->
9. Prepare Sodium Azide Stock Solution (10% (w/v)). a. Add 1 g of sodium azide to 8 mL ddH2O. b. Adjust the final volume to 10 mL with ddH2O. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S17 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 4◦C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S18 -->

### Day Before Use (Buffers)

1. Prepare Permeabilization Buffer. Note: Please refer to the “Materials and equipment’’ section for the detailed compositions of Permeabilization Buffer. Note: Filter the buffer through a 0.22-μm syringe filter. This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 22◦C-25◦C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T1-S01 -->
2. Prepare Immunolabeling Buffer. Note: Please refer to the “Materials and equipment’’ section for the detailed compositions of Immunolabeling Buffer. Note: Filter the buffer through a 0.22-μm syringe filter after diluting the primary or secondary antibody. This can be done 1 day in advance. Store at 4◦C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T1-S02 -->
3. Prepare Washing Buffer. Note: Please refer to the “Materials and equipment’’ section for the detailed compositions of Washing Buffer. Note: Filter the buffer through a 0.22-μm syringe filter. This can be done 1 week in advance. Store at 22◦C-25◦C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T1-S03 -->
4. Prepare a mixture of dichloromethane and methanol (v:v=2:1). Note: This must be done on the day of use. CRITICAL: Handle dichloromethane and methanol in a chemical hood and dispose them according to local health and safety regulations. CRITICAL: Prepare in glass bottles with polypropylene caps and styrene-butadiene rubber liners. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T1-S04 -->

### Day Of Use (Fresh Buffers & Agarose)

1. Perfusion buffer A

Reagent Final concentration Amount

10 3 PBS 1 3 50 mL

10 mg/mL Heparin 50 μg/mL 2.5 mL ddH2O N/A 447.5 mL Total Volume N/A 500 mL

Prepare fresh on the day of use. One-time use. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S01 -->
2. Perfusion buffer B

Reagent Final concentration Amount

10 3 PBS 1 3 50 mL

10 mg/mL Heparin 50 μg/mL 2.5 mL

4% (w/v) Formaldehyde 1% (w/v) 125 mL

ddH2O N/A 322.5 mL
Total Volume N/A 500 mL

Prepare fresh on the day of use. One-time use. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S02 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: Prewarm the Perfusion Buffers to 37◦C before tissue harvesting. CRITICAL: Handle all the Perfusion Buffers in a chemical hood and dispose them according to local health and safety regulations. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S03 -->
3. Prepare Fixation Buffer. Note: Please refer to the “Materials and equipment’’ section for the detailed compositions of Fixation Buffer. Note: Fixation Buffer must be freshly prepared on the day of use for the optimal quality of tissue fixation. CRITICAL: Handle Fixation Buffer in a chemical hood and dispose it according to local health and safety regulations. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S04 -->
4. Prepare 0.8% agarose.
a. Add 0.8 g of agarose powder to 100 mL 13 PBS. b. Heat the mixture in a microwave oven until agarose powder is completely dissolved. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S05 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: 0.8% agarose must be made freshly and cooled down to approximately 50◦C before tissue embedding. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S06 -->
5. Fill the imaging chamber with 100% dibenzyl-ether. Note: This must be done on the day of use. CRITICAL: Handle dibenzyl-ether in a chemical hood and dispose it according to local health and safety regulations. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T2-S07 -->

## Tissue Harvesting, Fixation, and Decolorization

### Tissue harvesting, fixation, and decolorization

1. Fast 8-week-old C57BL/6 wild-type male mice for 24 h. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->
2. Subject the experimental group to the feeding condition for 3 h, while the control group remains fasted. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S02 -->
3. Perfuse the anesthetized mice transcardially with 25 mL Perfusion Buffer A, followed by 25 mL Perfusion Buffer B. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S03 -->
4. Dissect the whole brain of each mouse. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S04 -->
5. Postfix each brain with 25 mL of Fixation Buffer at 4◦C for 16 h with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S05 -->
6. Wash each brain with 25 mL of 13 PBS at 22◦C-25◦C for 1 h three times with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S06 -->
7. Incubate each brain in a glass vial at 22◦C-25◦C with 15 mL of the methanol gradient: 20% methanol for 2 h, 40% methanol for 2 h, 60% methanol for 2 h, 80% methanol for 2 h, and 100% methanol for 2 h. Incubate with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S07 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: If the subsequent experimental steps are not to be performed immediately, the proced ure can be paused at this stage. Store the tissues in 100% methanol at 4 ◦C for up to 6 months. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S08 -->
8. Cool the brains in 100% methanol at 4◦C for 1 h. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S09 -->
9. Incubate each brain with 15 mL of Decolorization Solution in the same glass vial at 4◦C for 48 h with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S10 -->
10. Incubate each brain in the same glass vial at 22◦C-25◦C with 15 mL of the inverse methanol gradient: 100% methanol for 2 h, 80% methanol for 2 h, 60% methanol for 2 h, 40% methanol for 2 h, and 20% methanol for 2 h. Incubate with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S11 -->

## Tissue Permeabilization and Whole-Tissue Immunolabeling

### Tissue permeabilization and whole-tissue immunolabeling

1. Incubate each brain with 25 mL of Permeabilization Buffer at 37◦C for 24 h with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S01 -->
2. Block each brain with 4 mL of Immunolabeling Buffer at 37◦C for 24 h with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S02 -->
3. Incubate each brain with 4 mL of the primary antibody diluted (final concentration of 2 μg/mL) in the Immunolabeling Buffer at 37◦C for 48 h with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S03 -->
4. Incubate each brain with 25 mL of Washing Buffer at 37◦C for 24 h with gentle rotation. Change the fresh Washing Buffer every 6∼8 h. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S04 -->
5. Incubate the tissues with 4 mL of the secondary antibody diluted (final concentration of 2 μg/mL) in the Immunolabeling Buffer at 37◦C for 48 h with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S05 -->
6. Incubate each brain with 25 mL of Washing Buffer at 37◦C for 48 h with gentle rotation. Change the fresh Washing Buffer every 8∼12 h. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S06 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: After completing this step, the brain samples must be processed to the next steps immediately. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S07 -->

## Tissue Embedding, Optical Clearing, and Lightsheet Imaging

### Tissue embedding, optical clearing, and lightsheet imaging

1. Examine the brain samples under a dissection microscope for any attached debris or dirt. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S01 -->
2. Place each brain in a separate 35-mm dish with the cerebral cortex facing upward. Embed in 0.8% agarose. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S02 -->
3. Solidify the tissue blocks at 4◦C for 30 min. Trim excess agarose surrounding the tissue block, ensuring that the remaining agarose does not exceed 1 mm from the tissue edges. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S03 -->
4. Incubate each embedded tissue block in a glass vial at 22◦C-25◦C with 15 mL of the methanol gradient: 20% methanol for 1 h three times; 40% methanol for 1 h, 60% methanol for 1 h, 80% methanol for 1 h, and 100% methanol for 1 h twice. Incubate with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S04 -->
5. Incubate each tissue block in the same glass vial with a mixture (v:v = 2:1) of dichloromethane and methanol at 22◦C-25◦C for 2 h twice. Incubate with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S05 -->
6. Incubate each tissue block in the same glass vial with dichloromethane at 22◦C-25◦C for 1 h three times. Incubate with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S06 -->
7. Incubate each tissue block in the same glass vial with dibenzyl ether at 22◦C-25◦C for 12 h three times. Incubate with gentle rotation. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S07 -->
> **Operational constraint:** CRITICAL: Handle dichloromethane, methanol, and dibenzyl ether in a chemical hood. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S08 -->
8. Mount the embedded brain sample into a sample holder, which is an accessory part of the LaVision Biotec Ultramicroscope II, with the brainstem facing upward. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S09 -->
9. Immerse a brain sample in the imaging chamber filled with 100% dibenzyl-ether. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S10 -->
10. Utilize a SuperK FIANIUM FIU-15 supercontinuum white light laser (NKT Photonics) as the excitation source. For imaging the Alexa Fluor Plus 647-conjugated secondary-antibody immu nolabeling, set the excitation filter at 640/30 nm and the emission filter at 690/50 nm. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S11 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: Select appropriate excitation and emission filters according to the particular fluorophore conjugated to a secondary antibody utilized for each experiment. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S12 -->
11. Acquire an image stack with an Andor Neo sCMOS camera at 2560 3 2160 pixel resolution with the exposure time at 200 ms for each optical section. For imaging at 1.263 (0.633 zoom) magnification, scan the brain sample by three combined lightsheets with a step size of 5 μm. For imaging at 2.53 (1.253 zoom) magnification, scan by three combined lightsheets with a step size of 2 μm. For imaging at 12.63 (6.33 zoom) magnification, scan by a single light sheet (middle position) from the left side with a step size of 1 μm. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S13 -->
12. Reconstruct the image stacks in Imaris and generate the representative 3D images shown in the figure by orthogonal projection. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S14 -->
